name: claude-mods

plugins.name: session-manager
plugins.description: A clickable pane listing every Claude Code session on this machine (macOS and Windows): search titles and content, resume, jump to an open one, rename, start and delete

plugins.name: agent-zoo
plugins.description: A pane that shows each sub-agent and teammate as a shaded 3D pixel robot or a compact tree, with a live view of what each one is doing

plugins.name: todo-history
plugins.description: A pane with the history of the todo list, tasks and agents: undo one task and keep the rest, roll back to any step, and follow a rewind of the conversation

description: Claude Code mods: a session manager pane, an animated sub-agent pane and a todo history with rollback
